why: Image 1 holds together better as a real room: the recessed slatted alcove with its two downlights frames the speakers symmetrically, and nothing in the frame breaks the illusion apart from the blown-out lamp and side table in the lower-left foreground. Image 2 has the more dynamic angle, but the seated figure on the right is a smooth, featureless mannequin with a smeared head and rubbery limbs, which gives it away as CG immediately.
